notes.title: Unreal Musician V 0.0.4 Alpha
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Object transforms now work properly
[*]Object selection for Kick Drum fixed
[*] Fixed the Midi Listener Array interface and functionality.
[/list]

New:
[list]
[*] Right Click and Drag to Paint Delete Midi Notes in Piano Roll
[*] Use Space Bar for Play/Stop shortcut..
[/list]


+ More...

notes.title: V.0.0.2
notes.content:
New:
[list]
[*]No need to install ffmpeg for MP4 export. Its embedded.
[*]2 New Piano Visualizers:
[list]
[*]Falling Notes, 
[*]Top Down View,
[*]Fixed Tempo detection
[/list]
[*] Other minor bug fixes...
[/list]
